tools.name: current-weather
tools.title: Current weather
tools.description: Get the weather right now in a city: conditions, temperature, feels-like, humidity and wind. Use when someone asks what the weather is like somewhere today or at the moment.

city.description: A city name, e.g. Bogotá, Tokyo or San Francisco

tools.name: weather-forecast
tools.title: Weather forecast
tools.description: Get a day-by-day forecast for a city, up to 7 days ahead, with highs, lows and the chance of rain. Use when someone is planning ahead: a trip, an event, what to wear this week.

days.description: How many days, including today. Defaults to 3
